senses.gloss: m. (פָּרַר) rubble, loose ground; quarry (cmp. German Bruch).
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 81b:1">Ned. 81ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 71b:2">Keth. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>לא מצינו שועל שמת בעפר פ׳</he> it does not occur that a fox dies in the dust of rubble, i.e. you do not feel the absence of comforts to which you are not used; Y. ib. VII, 31ᵇ <he>אין שועל עפר פרין מת</he> (read: <he>מת בעפר פֵּרִין</he>; pl. of <cite ref="Q01526"><he>פֵּר</he></cite>). Bab.
<cite ref="Ketubot 79b:9">ib. 79ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ של גפרית</he> a sulphur quarry.
